items.source: Entity callback triggered after save of an entity.
items.translation: 实体保存后触发的实体回调。

items.source: Entity callback method invoked after a domain object is saved.
items.translation: 实体回调方法在域对象保存后被调用。

items.source:
Entity callback method invoked after a domain object is saved. Can return either the same or a modified instance of
the domain object.
items.translation: 实体回调方法在保存域对象后调用。可以返回相同的域对象实例或修改后的实例。

items.source: entity - the domain object that was saved.
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个函数式接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。

items.source: the domain object that was persisted.
